title: ComputeWeights
description: Machine-wide compute weights, set by the researcher. Each agent job records the weight in effect when it was submitted, so changing a weight never rewrites what was used.

weights.description: By target: `local` (this workstation) or a compute target's ID. A target without an entry has weight 1.

^(.*)$.description: A compute weight in hundredths (100 is a weight of 1, 50 is 0.5, 300 is 3): an hour on the target counts as weight hours.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.
